records.subject: Still want to get Willow Works set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product activity: no project, no invites, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:136f0149]. No tickets, so no signal of active engagement. Team plan implies real intent and 8 days remain, so some self-serve chance, but silence after a week is a weak unaided trajectory.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Following up on my note from last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the quickest way to see how things fit together. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'd be glad to hop on a short call this week and help you set up that first project together.

Best,
Priya
